description.text: Program Description Automation is based on automatic control theory as the main theoretical basis, electronic technology, computer information technology, sensor and testing technology as the main technical means, for a variety of a professional automation device and control system. The major has two development directions, the first is the industrial process control direction, the second is the embedded system direction. Is the combination of computer hardware and software, as well as the combination of mechanical and electronic, components, operation combined with manufacturing, integration with the system control science, computer technology, electronic technology, mechanical engineering is a body comprehensive discipline. It with a "control (system) tube (Richard), strong (electric) weak (electricity) and, soft hard and" distinctive features, is a science, engineering, multidisciplinary and pipes cross wide caliber engineering professional. Duration 4 years

duration.text: The Automation at Shanghai University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3333 USD/per year ￥ 24000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above 6. Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief.(at least 1 A4 page)
